svg.title: Active vertical perception — mechanical blueprint
svg.desc: An exploded orthographic study based on the official Clearpath J100 chassis mesh, the project’s actual rear-deck bracket CAD, and its FPB30 and C-200T joint definitions. The full system, three-axis camera gimbal, and deck interface are shown. Simulation geometry, not a manufacturing drawing.
svg.text: A Jackal. A 1.5 m lift. Two gimbals.
